_comment: Which connector Open Apps get their seed migrations regenerated by scripts/build-seed-migrations.mjs. This file is NOT an independent source of truth: `hold` is exactly the set of connector directories whose package.json sets "private": true, and `publish` is exactly the rest. Together they must cover every directory that has an mj-app.json, and nothing else. scripts/validate-invariants.mjs enforces all three of those statements in CI, so this file cannot drift from the private flags the way it did before. To move a connector between the lists, flip "private" in its package.json and re-run `node scripts/sync-publish-scope.mjs`. Platform/FileFeed, Platform/RelationalDB and Shared/SchemaMerge appear in neither list on purpose: they are libraries, not Open Apps, and have no mj-app.json.
